paite: Huai nung in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Shiloh ah akikhawm ua, huai ah kihoupihna biakbuk akai uhi. Huai gam teng azou khinta uhi.
heading: Gam Om Lai Teng Hawmna

paite: Israel suante lak ah atantuam uh tang nai lou nam sagih a-om lai uhi.
Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA na pipute uh Pathian in nou hon piaksa gam, bang tan ahia luah lou a na awltat lai ding uh?
Nam chih a kipan mi thum zel telkhia unla; amau akuan ding ua, gam ava en vialvial ding ua, atantuam hun ding uh bang chiat zel in ava gelh ding ua; ka kiang ah ahong nawn ding uh.
Mun sagih in akhen phot ding ua; Judah pawl simlam ah atantuam uah a-om ding ua, Joseph inkuante mallam ah atantuam uah a-om ding uh.
Gam mun sagih in va khen unla, huai gelhna hon pia un. Huchi in hiai ah TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding hi.

Levi teng in na lak uah tantuam anei kei ding uh. TOUPA mai a siampu nasep amau goutan ahi. Gad pawl, Reuben pawl leh Manasseh nam kimkhat bel Jordan gal suahlam ah amau tantuam TOUPA sikha Mosi in apiak ana tangta uh," achi hi.
Huchi in huai mite apawtkheta ua, Joshua in, "Gam va en vialvial unla, hon gelhkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tun nawn unla, hiai ah Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding," chi in thu apia hi.
Mite akuan ua, gam ava en vialvial ua, mun sagih in akhen ua, laibu ah akhuakhua in agelhkhia ua, giahphual Shiloh ah Joshua kiang ah akik nawn uhi.
Joshua in Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ana sansak a; huai ah Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un gam ahawmta hi.
Aisan a-inkuan uh dungzui in Benjamin suante tung ah aketa a; agamgi chiang uh Judah suante leh Joseph suante kikal ahi.
heading: Benjamin Gam Tan

paite: Mallam pang a agamgi chiang uh Jordan a pan ahi a; Jeriko sik ah mallam pang ah apaitou a, tumlam pang ah tanggam ah apaitou zel a; Beth-Aven gamdai ah atawp hi.
Hiai a pan Luz lam ah, Luz, huai tuh Bethel ahi, sik ah, simlam pang ah apai zel a; Beth-horon khang simlam pang a mual zul ah Ataroth-addar ah apaisuk hi.
Apai zel a, Beth-horon simlam pang a tangchin a pan tumlam ah simlam pang ah akualphei a; Kiriath-baal, huai Kiriath-jearim ahi, Judah suante khopi ah atawp a; huai tumlam pang gamgi ahi.
Simlam pang a gam Kiriath- jearim tawp a pan ahi a; tumlam ah apawt a, Nephtoah luituite ah apai zel hi.
Rephaim mallam pang phaizang a Hinnom Tapa phaizang chin a tangmong ah apaisuk a; Jebuste sik ah, simlam pang a Hinnom Phaizang ah apaisuk a, En-rogel ah apaisuk hi.
Mallam zuan in apai a, En-shemesh ah apai a, Adummim kahtouhna chin Geliloth ah apai a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaisuk a;
Arabah sik mallam pang ah apai zel a, Arabah ah apaisuk a;
Beth-hoglah sik, mallam pang ah apai zel a; atawpna bel Jordan simtawp, Chi Tuipi mallam tuipi meng ah ahi. Huai simlam gamgi ahi.
Jordan suahlam pang, agamgi chiang ahi. Huai ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a atantuam gam in akolhkhum sung.
Benjamin suante a-inkuan dungzui un akhopite uh, Jeriko, Beth- hoglah, Emek-keziz,
Beth-arabah, Zemariam, Bethel,
Avim, Parah, Ophrah,
Kephar-haammonai, Ophni leh Geba; akhopel tengteng toh akhopi tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi.
Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,
Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah;
Zelah, Eleph, Jebus, huai Jerusalem ahi, Gibeah leh Kiriath, akhotate toh khopi sawm-le-li ahi. Hiaite ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui ua atantuam ding ua kisepte.
